description:
Assured is on a mission to modernize insurance. Claims processing (i.e. should we pay this claim?), while often overlooked, is the foundation of the entire industry. It’s currently highly manual, involving phone calls, faxes, and gut instinct, costing tens of billions of dollars a year. We can do better.

At Assured, we provide large insurers with the software solutions they need to win in a modern, technology-driven world. From self-service claim-filing software to backend fraud detection, we’re the engine that powers claims processing for some of the largest insurers in the world.

The challenges we face are deep and diverse, from creating digital experiences that provide comfort and clarity to claimants at their most stressed and vulnerable to orchestrating large-scale ML-driven decision-making on billions of dollars of claims payments, life at Assured is dynamic, collaborative, and rewarding.

We are looking for a VP, Business Development and Partnerships to make our partnerships the fastest route to the executives who run claims and decide AI strategy at the largest U.S. carriers. Assured is the most deployed Frontier AI for claims, chosen by 6 of the top 10 U.S. P&C carriers. The consultants, integrators, analysts and retired claims executives who shape what carriers buy next already sit in their boardrooms. Your job is to get them to open doors for us, and to convert those doors into ARR.

This is a builder’s role with two inseparable mandates. First, open the doors: run our four partner channels as one engine aimed at named Chief Claims Officers, CIOs, Chief AI Officers and the AVPs, VPs and SVPs of Claims and Transformation at the top 20 U.S. carriers. Second, accelerate revenue: turn those meetings into partner-sourced and partner-influenced pipeline and ARR, across new logos and the accounts we already serve. You will be measured on doors opened and ARR moved, not on partner meetings held.

You will report into the Head of Marketing, with no direct reports for now, and partner daily with the founders, Sales, Commercial Growth and the broader marketing and GTM teams. If you want to be judged on the doors you open and the revenue behind them, this is your seat.

What You’ll Do

  • Own the executive target map – Leverage the existing map of every CCO, CIO, CAIO and Claims and Transformation leader at the top 20 U.S. carriers, and name the partner who can credibly put us in the room with each one.

  • Turn strategy consultants into door-openers – Build multi-quarter relationships with the leading strategy firms around agreed target accounts and joint points of view, so introductions to named carrier executives become routine.

  • Build the sell-with motion with systems integrators – Define a joint engagement with global and insurance-specialist SIs (carrier-side integration, testing, change management), agree target carriers with each, and run joint account plans inside their claims programs.

  • Run the veteran advisor network – Recruit retired carrier claims executives, sign each one against the specific doors they can open, and hold them to the meetings they deliver.

  • Make analysts work for the pipeline – Get Assured named in the research claims and technology buyers read, and have analysts point carriers to us when they ask who to talk to.

  • Accelerate revenue – Own partner-sourced and partner-influenced pipeline and ARR across Land and Expand. Work each deal with Sales through signature, using partners to shorten cycles and widen claim-share.

  • Own the scorecard – Report weekly on executive meetings opened by partner and by carrier, and the pipeline and ARR behind them. Reshape or retire the partnerships that don’t move named accounts.

  • Arm partners to position Assured – With Product Marketing and Commercial Growth, give partners the narrative, demos and value cases they need with carrier clients, inside what we choose to disclose.

  • Connect partners to the go-to-market – Work with Sales, Integrated Marketing and Brand Communications so every partner-opened meeting feeds an account plan, a person-based campaign or one of Justin’s executive stages.

What You’ll Bring

  • 10+ years in business development, alliances or partner leadership, with senior leadership experience and partner-sourced revenue you can quantify.

  • A proven network across the leading consultancies, systems integrators and analyst firms, and carrier claims and technology executives who take your call.

  • A track record of sell-with motions in enterprise software that closed real deals.

  • Fluency in how P&C carriers buy technology and what a CCO and a CIO are each measured on; carrier, consulting or insurance software experience is a strong plus.

  • Commercial judgment: you qualify partners hard, walk away from relationships that don’t open doors, and push every meeting to a dated next step.

  • Executive presence with a consulting managing partner or a Chief Claims Officer, and the product depth to run the demo yourself.

  • A builder’s mindset – comfortable writing the playbook from scratch as a team of one in a fast-moving, resource-constrained environment.

  • High ownership and low ego – you do the thinking and the doing.

Benefits:

🤑 Competitive Compensation: Competitive salary and equity packages for all employees

🏥 Healthcare Plan: Platinum medical, dental, and vision

🛡️ Free life insurance: Including long-term disability & short-term disability

🏄 Unlimited PTO: Uncapped vacation days & paid holidays

👶 Family Leave: Maternity & paternity

📈 401(k) Contribution: Assured contributes 3% of your income, even if you don't contribute

🏠 WFH Benefits: Lunch on us 2x/week, monthly phone stipend & other home office perks

👪 Health FSAs & HSAs: Pre-tax accounts for out-of-pocket medical expenses

🤝 Team events & Offsites: We're remote, but we regularly get together

**We have been made aware of individuals falsely posing as recruiters from Assured Insurance Technologies Inc. Please note that we only contact candidates from official @assured.claims email addresses and all interviews are conducted through verified company channels. If you are unsure whether a message is legitimate, please contact us directly at recruiting-ops@assured.claims before sharing any personal information**

Our Commitment:
We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, perform essential job functions, and receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.
